t: What Software Performance Tuning Database Is All About
title: What Software Performance Tuning Database Is All About
description: Performance tuning is measured optimization: profile first (find the hotspot: the 80/20), then optimize (algorithm, caching, batching, parallelism). Rules: measure before/after, optimize the bottleneck, know Amdahl's law (parallel speedup limits). Premature optimization is the root of evil (Knuth) — profile-guided is the virtue. This database is the complete tuning record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
